The '''Demophon sector''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon]], [[Mowgle system/Legends|Mowgle]] and [[Refgar system/Legends|Refgar systems]].<ref name="TEA-OC" />
